data.name: Windshear Decay
data.description: Razor sharp wind slashes that leave lasting and decaying effects
data.battleDescription: %user forms a series of intricate hand seals which summons forth the power of the winds that once quelled Fujin's fury. With a swift motion, they unleash a torrent of razor-sharp wind slashes that tear through the air towards %target. The wind howls with a vengeful fury, and as the invisible blades connect, they slice deep into %target's flesh, leaving behind festering wounds. The air around %target grows heavy with the scent of decay as the slashes begin to fester and deepen over time, continuing to tear at their flesh with each passing moment.

data.name: Death's March
data.description: Release waves of chakra that strikes your target
data.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a radiant chakra tunnel.  They unleash an unyielding wave of chakra, targeting their enemy's cells with relentless precision. As the assault subsides, the enemy's once-sturdy form crumbles, consumed by decay.

data.name: Atomic Shield
data.description: Create a barrier of particles to protect you
data.battleDescription: %user creates a translucent barrier made of the particles around them to defend from all attacks

data.name: Decaying Touch
data.description: Touch your target and start to destroy their body through a dusty decay.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a dust cloud that surrounds %target. Dashing through the cloud, they appear in front of %target, placing their hand on them. %target slashes at %user, and their body becomes dust. Only after the dust has disappeared does %target realize that the part of their body that was touched is beginning to decay.

data.name: Particle Cannon
data.description: The ultimate power comes with the ultimate price.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate triangle with their fingers, bringing forth a radiant orb that caresses %user's hand with a warm glow that both energizes and burns. Gradually, the sphere transforms, unfurling into a brilliant beam, propelled with purpose towards %target

data.name: Aerathiel
data.description:
In the ancient annals of Current's genesis, the villagers remained oblivious to Fujin's unleashed fury within the valleys. But as raging tempests laid waste to their crops and made life a daily struggle, they erected an altar to appease Fujin's wrath, offering sacrifices for mercy. Though momentarily effective, peace proved short-lived.

 

On a fateful afternoon, children playing near the sacred altar accidentally desecrated it, reigniting Fujin's wrath. Hurricane-force winds tore through the village, reducing even the altar to rubble. Amidst the chaos, a young member of the Aerathiel lineage emerged. With unwavering determination, she faced the storm, her skin lashed by winds like a whip. Carrying a heavy stone from the ruined altar, she planted it where it once stood, offering her life for her people's salvation. Fujin, moved by her selfless devotion, softened, transforming the hurricane into a gentle breeze. Legend has it that Aerathiel descendants inherit divine mastery of the wind element, from destructive gusts to soothing melodies in wind chimes.

data.name: Stormsinger
data.description: A powerful stormy chakra surrounds the user.
data.battleDescription: Calling upon the divine power of Susanoo, %user becomes one with the storm, their presence merging with the crackling energy in the air.

data.name: Sounds of Tempest
data.description: This jutsu channels lightning chakra through the target causing their very blood to become toxic to them.
data.battleDescription: As the tempest rages, %user's eyes begin to glow with a dark blue radiance, mirroring the eye of the storm growing within, intensifying the ferocity and might of the unleashed power. %user then melds the forces of lightning and water, birthing "Akuma no Arashi", a cataclysmic storm of unparalleled power. The merging elements surge forth, enveloping %target and battlefield, a single bolt of lightning strikes them.

data.name: Reapers Storm
data.description: This jutsu unleashes a devastating lightning strike in the form of a demon that crashes through the clouds and slams into the target with immense force
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, summoning a torrent of water that cascades onto the battlefield in a tidal wave. The surging water drenches the area, leaving the opponent caught in the flow. With a crackling charge, %user infuses the water with lightning chakra, causing the terrain to spark and sizzle with electric energy

data.name: Demons Strike
data.description: Call down a powerful storm strike on an area while raising a temporary shield around yourself.
data.battleDescription: as the storm rages on,  %user calls upon the power of the storm, forming a fearsome lightning strike from within the clouds. The demonic lightning descends with tremendous speed and force, crashing into %target with overwhelming power.

data.name: Death’s Storm
data.description: This jutsu summons a powerful storm of intense winds and torrential rain. Its raindrops become sharp needles that pierce the enemy and weaken their attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a powerful storm, unleashing intense winds and torrential rain that soak %target(s). As the storm rages, the raindrops transform into sharp needles, piercing %target(s) and weakening the force of their attacks.

data.name: Arashima
data.description:
In the barren expanse once known as Shroud, where desolation reigned and hope withered under the relentless sun, one clan dared to defy fate. As the land dried and fertility faded, most fled in search of greener pastures. Yet, the clan remained, their faith unyielding, their prayers to Susanoo, echoing through the parched air.

For months, they beseeched for rain, their devotion unwavering. In response, the Kami, viewing mortals with disdain, cursed the land with perpetual storms. But to the clan, it was not a curse, but a blessing—a testament to their faith.

Embracing the tempests that ravaged their home, they settled amongst the rain, seeing it as a sign of divine favor. Their unwavering devotion and stubborn resolve moved Susanoo, who bestowed upon them a unique gift, the ability to master water and lightning. They became a force to be reckoned with, their bond with the elements unbreakable.

And thus, from the ashes of despair, the village of Shroud rose anew, its people blessed with the power to shape the very forces of nature.

data.name: Inferno Cataclysm
data.description: Unleashes a devastating explosion
data.battleDescription: Battle Description: %user channels the destructive power of their Bakuhatsu bloodline, their body surging with intense heat as the air around them distorts from the sheer energy. With a focused shout, %user slams their hands into the ground, causing the earth to tremble and crack. From the fissures erupts a cataclysmic explosion

data.name: Kinetic Nova
data.description: A blast of explosive chakra that disrupts all other chakra in the area
data.battleDescription: %user condenses their chakra into a ball, flinging it at %target which explodes showering the area in the tiny explosions. %target soon realizes that its very hard to gather mold their elemental chakra.

data.name: Blast Shield
data.description: Using the concussive blast from an explosion to dampel the next attack you take.
data.battleDescription: %user creatives a massive explosion around themselves neutralizing all attacks coming towards them.

data.name: Charge 4 Explosion
data.description: Spreading your chakra across the battle field causes micro-explosions to everything it comes into contact with.
data.battleDescription: %user covers the battlefield with their explosive chakra. Small explosions can be seen and heard happening all around you.

data.name: Howitzer Crash
data.description: A devastating technique where you propel yourself at the target with an explosion before launching another massive explosion at them.
data.battleDescription: %user explodes the space behind them launching themselves at the opponent then detonates themselves as soon as they get close enough. The explosion weakens the opponent defenses.

data.name: Bakuhatsu
data.description:
After years of research and development, the most destructive bloodline traits were engineered. The following documents were discovered by Global ANBU forces following a massive explosion and have been classified for an extended period. Recently, a portion of these documents has been made public.

 

[Unclassified]...

 Subject name: Hatsu, 19-year-old. Male. The subject is in excellent physical condition, and his mastery of the earth element makes him the perfect candidate for...

 

[Information damaged by the explosion]...

 

Subject name: Bakutai, 18-year-old. Male. The subject is in excellent physical condition and is the last known descendant of the Shockbolt Fiend bloodline. Everything is prepared for the fusion scheduled for tomorrow at dawn.

 

[Information damaged by the explosion]...

 

The fusion appears to have been successful. I’m still awaiting the subject's awakening, who I will be calling Bakuhatsu. For the moment, there seem to be no alterations in the subject's life force energy, but further assessments are pending.

...[Unclassified]

data.name: Ring of Spilled Blood
data.description: A spiral of spent blood is thrown across the ground. It opens what stands against the user, and what it opens, it weakens.
data.battleDescription: %user spills a spiral across the ground and it turns outward, hungry. Enemies caught in the ring are opened, and their blows leave the circle duller than they entered.

data.name: Crimson Tithe
data.description: The user takes a toll in blood and time alike. The shock of the taking locks the victim in place, and what movement remains costs them dearly.
data.battleDescription: %user reaches into the space between heartbeats and takes what is owed. %target staggers, locked mid-motion, and even time itself grows expensive around them.

data.name: Sanguine Plague
data.description: The user seeds a rival's blood with a burning sickness. The plague opens them to harm and eats at them from within, while the user's own blood refuses all affliction.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a drop of tainted blood onto %target and it takes root, burning as it spreads. %target is opened and eaten from within, while %user_object own veins run too hot for any sickness to touch.

data.name: Reaper's Embrace
data.description: The user closes in and drains their target directly, tearing vitality from them in a violent, inescapable exchange.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and crashes into %target, dragging %target close as crimson energy surges between them. With every heartbeat, %user rips vitality free, feeding on %target’s life as %user_object holds them through this vicious dance.

data.name: Unholy Enhancement
data.description: The user awakens a corrupted vitality, amplifying their strength while their body shrugs off harm with unnatural resilience.
data.battleDescription: A dark pulse spreads through %user’s veins, quickening with hungry force. %user’s strikes land harder, fueled by something that does not tire, while blows from %target sink shallow, unable to fully pierce what refuses to weaken.

data.name: Crimson Impact
data.description: The user violently rends their target, leaving them exposed while siphoning vitality from the damage inflicted.
data.battleDescription: %user rends %target with brutal force, tearing open deep, bleeding wounds. The injury lingers, raw and unclosing, as %user drinks from it, each pulse of pain feeding %user’s strength.

data.name: Hemocure
data.description: The user commands their blood to reject injury, sealing wounds and feeding on incoming harm to sustain an unnatural vitality.
data.battleDescription: %user’s blood writhes beneath %user_object skin, surging against the flow of nature. Wounds seal shut as they form, and each strike from %target is devoured, strength stolen as %user refuses to fall.

data.name: Thousand Strike
data.description: The user unleashes a relentless barrage that shatters defenses, leaving the target exposed to further harm.
data.battleDescription: %user descends in a frenzy of strikes, each blow tearing through %target with merciless precision. Defenses collapse under the onslaught, and in the wake of the assault, %target is left wide open, unable to withstand what follows.

data.name: Blood-Enchanted Eyes
data.description:
Once there was a goddess, born of lingering grief.

She watched mortality with the distant, childlike curiosity of eternity. She wondered at its fragility. At its endings.
At the quiet that followed a final breath.

And so she stepped closer.
And closer still.
Until she stood at the trembling edge between the here and the ever after.

There, she bathed in the twilight of What Was, What Is, and What Could Be.

And instead of recoiling, the goddess rejoiced.
She embraced the shadowed seam and made her home within it. She drank of the interval.
She consumed the in between.

From her, and from her children, and from their children after them, came those marked with her sight.

Eyes that do not close at the edge of death.
Hands that borrow moments not meant to be held.
Mortals who may taste eternity.

But never without surrendering something in return.

data.name: Icebound Might
data.description: The wielder lets winter close over them like a second body. What it grips, it guards, and the cold it sheds sinks into their rival's every limb, dulling their blows before they land.
data.battleDescription: %user plants the trident and the cold closes over %user like armor, plate after plate of pale ice. The chill hangs heavy on every swing at %user, and the blows that land arrive dulled, only settling the frost.

data.name: Glacial Volley
data.description: The wielder raises the Gaze and the air answers with an arsenal. A dozen lances of ice hang waiting, and every one of them has already chosen where it lands.
data.battleDescription: %user raises the trident and the cold assembles into ranks: lance after lance of pale ice hanging in the air, every point aimed at %target. %user lowers the tines, and winter volleys.

data.name: Ice Shackles
data.description: The Gaze regards a rival and the cold agrees. Frost climbs them like a verdict, and for a breath the world simply declines to let them move.
data.battleDescription: %user levels the trident and its three eyes narrow. Frost races up %target from the ground, locking joint after joint, until %target stands shackled in blue ice.

data.name: Blade Resonance
data.description: Synchronize your chakra with your weapon to deliver an icy strike that leaves the target vulnerable to Earth, Ice, Water, Wind and non-elemental attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their lineage through their weapon and forms a blade of ice, striking %target and disrupting their defenses against Earth, Ice, Water, Wind and non-elemental attacks.

data.name: Blue Crimson
data.description: Use your bloodline to teleport to different locations striking the enemy
data.battleDescription: %user activates their bloodline, their eyes glow as patterned blades start to rotate in their pupils. %user disappears and reappears in seemingly random locations around %target, shifting his speed till his movements seem more illusionary than real. As %target becomes more and more disorientated, %user slashes and pierces %target from multiple angles.

data.name: Quintessential Flake
data.description: Using your blue blade, you turn your enemies ice pulling them towards you
data.battleDescription: %user channels their Blue Blade unleashing its energy upon %target. The freezing the surrounding area.

data.name: Sapphire Command
data.description: A complex series of slashes drops your opponent to their knees before you.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a pulse of Blue Blade chakra across the battlefield. As the wave passes through %target, their chakra flow freezes, increasing their vulnerability.

data.name: Arctic Frost
data.description: Coat your blade in ice chakra and attack your enemy
data.battleDescription: Empowered by Blue Blade Eyes, %user chills the blade in elemental energy, encasing it in ice.

data.name: Blue Blade Eyes
data.description:
Born from the union of mystic sorcerers, Blue Blade Eyes bear the legacy of channeling intense blue chakra through their eyes and weapons. With sapphire-hued eyes that ignite during battle, wielders infuse their strikes with pure energy, cutting through the toughest materials effortlessly. This bloodline's power peaks when chakra forms visible extensions of their weapons, creating devastating blades of energy.



In the twilight of the training grounds, Musa stood unwavering before a granite boulder. His chakra surged, eyes glowing like blue sapphires. With a swift motion, he split the rock cleanly in half, then summoned a crescent blade of sapphire energy, reducing the boulder to fragments. This display of precision and destructive power exemplifies the unmatched skill and raw power of the Blue Blade Eyes bloodline.



This is an S-rank bloodline and CANNOT be purchased directly

data.name: Cosmic Intent
data.description: A crushing gravitational distortion leaves the enemy vulnerable, continues to tear at them, and draws their vitality back to you.
data.battleDescription: %user warps space around %target with swirling nebulas and crackling energy. Crushing gravity leaves %target vulnerable as the distortion continues to tear at them and channels stolen vitality back to %user.

data.name: Cosmic Explosion
data.description: Condense celestial energy into a volatile sphere that explodes around the target, dealing damage and leaving lasting wounds.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a small purple ball into the center of the battlefield, the small ball begins to vibrate as a strong gravitational field begins to draw in %targets and the surrounding area. Once %targets reaches the center and makes contact with the sphere, it ignites causing a chain reaction of the entire area around %target igniting

data.name: Cosmic Chains
data.description: The user summons ethereal cosmic chains, forged from celestial energy, to bind their target. These luminous restraints drain power, suppressing their abilities while making them more vulnerable to attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user extends their hand, summoning radiant cosmic chains from the void. The glowing restraints lash out, binding %target as celestial energy siphons their strength. Gravity warps around them, their power fading under the weight of the stars.

data.name: Cosmic Energy
data.description: The user channels the aura of the universe, infusing their body with boundless cosmic energy. Their power surges, enhancing all abilities while warping space around them with celestial force.
data.battleDescription: %user's body radiates with cosmic energy, their form pulsing with the limitless power of the universe. Nebulas swirl around them, stars flickering in response to their ascension.

data.name: Cosmic Aura
data.description: The user’s presence warps reality, forming a celestial aura that suppresses the enemy’s strength while shielding them from harm. Space bends around them, reducing the impact of incoming attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user emanates a radiant cosmic aura, distorting space itself. Stars shimmer in their wake as their presence suppresses %target’s power.

data.name: Cosmic Ascendant
data.description:
Born from the essence of celestial phenomena, the Cosmic Ascendant bloodline draws its origins from a forgotten pact between mortal sages and the stars themselves. Legends tell of an ancient clan who meditated beneath starlit skies, seeking enlightenment and power. Their devotion did not go unnoticed by the heavens; a celestial being descended and imbued their lineage with the radiant energy of the cosmos. Inheritors of the Cosmic Ascendant bloodline are known to wield unparalleled control over the energies of the stars. They can channel constellations into their chakra, enabling them to manipulate gravitational fields, summon meteor-like strikes, and teleport across vast distances. Their mere presence is said to distort time and space, rendering them both untouchable and otherworldly on the battlefield.

This is an S-rank bloodline and CANNOT be purchased directly
